prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for Emmie by happySkin on Shopee. Centerpiece is a tropical beach product setup with two Emmie sheet-mask sachets standing inside a yellow-and-white inflatable swim ring on sandy shore. Background is a blue sky and turquoise beach with palm leaves. Surrounding elements: Shopee logo, Emmie by happySkin logo, giant headline 'CHOT DEAL MUA HE NANG CAP LAN DA', and a blue promo ticket strip reading 'MUA 1 TANG 1', 'MA GIAM GIA DEN 45%', and 'MUA 1 TANG 2', plus a duck float toy and a beach ball. Technical style: commercial product poster with photo-composite beach environment, bright tropical daylight, clean shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
